$comment: Movement trial = the fitness test she does during onboarding. Each trial uses an openGym exercise. `score` maps the result to a pattern tier (1 regression, 2 standard, 3 progression): the highest tier whose `min` the result reaches. `feel` adjusts it: couldnt -> tier 1 and switch to `easier`; hard -> at most tier 2; easy at top tier keeps 3. `pain` -> tier 1 and adds `painTags` to the plan's exclusions. `asTest` feeds the result into the scored fitness tests (norms in src/lib/science/tests.ts).
intro: Time to move! I'll show you 6 simple exercises. Do each one as well as you can with good form, then tell me how it went. Warm up first: march on the spot for 2 minutes and do a few arm circles. Stop anything that hurts.

trials.title: Squat
trials.protocol: Squat to a chair height and stand up fully, as many as you can in 60 seconds.
cues: Sit back like reaching for a chair
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes

trials.title: Push-up
trials.protocol: Knee push-ups: as many as you can with good form, no rest. Chest to a fist's height from the floor each rep.
cues: Straight line from head to knees

trials.title: Row
trials.protocol: Towel row: loop a towel around a sturdy door handle (door closed), lean back and pull yourself in. As many as you can in 45 seconds.
cues: Pull your elbows back past your ribs

trials.title: Glute bridge
trials.protocol: Lie on your back, knees bent, and lift your hips. As many as you can in 60 seconds, with a 1-second squeeze at the top.
cues: Ribs down, don't arch your back
Squeeze your glutes at the top

formFlags.label: Felt it in my lower back

trials.title: Lunge
trials.protocol: Alternating lunges for 60 seconds. Count the reps on one leg. Hold a wall if you need balance.
cues: Lower until both knees are near 90 degrees
Push back up through the front heel

trials.title: Plank
trials.protocol: Forearm plank: hold as long as you can with a straight body. Stop when your hips sag or rise. Drop to your knees if you need to and note it.
cues: Brace like someone's about to poke your belly
